description:
Import external physiological data into Vital Recorder. A CSV file named 'prototype_pleth.csv' containing real photoplethysmogram (PPG) data is located in 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\'.

Your task:
1. Open Vital Recorder.
2. Import the file 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\prototype_pleth.csv' (File > Open > select CSV or All Files).
3. Ensure the waveform is visible and scaled correctly in the track view.
4. Save the project as a Vital Recorder file named 'device_test_import.vital' in 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\'.
5. Take a screenshot of the visible waveform and save it to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\import_verification.png'.
